generator: gen_line_anchors.c compiled against unmodified aloistr/swisseph (v2.10.03); horizon crossings solved by bisection on the dot-product altitude term
flags: SEFLG_SWIEPH | SEFLG_EQUATORIAL (apparent geocentric, true equator and equinox of date); GAST from swe_sidtime (apparent sidereal time, UT1 input)
epoch_note: Julian Days in TT (swe_calc ephemeris time); TDB-TT <= 1.7 ms, < 0.001 arcsecond at lunar distance. UT1 for swe_sidtime = jd_tt - delta_t/86400.
delta_t_note: delta_t values are the Navigator crate's Espenak-Meeus/Almanac/SMH2016 model outputs, shared with both chains to isolate geometric implementation; Delta-T itself is validated by the crate's deltat fixtures
anchor_note: ASC anchors sweep 180 deg east of the sub-body meridian (MC), DSC 180 deg west; 23 interior anchor longitudes of 24 equal segments each; crossing latitude by bisection on sin(d)sin(b)+cos(d)cos(b)cos(H) = 0; rows with |dec| < 0.05 deg carry empty anchors (pole-degenerate horizon)
